decisions.reason: Archiving and reporting software is central to the firm's announced data-driven, web-based direction and had its own page, so sunk development effort and public commitment favor keeping it, likely through updated versions.

This second archiving product overlaps with A and was only mentioned on the website, which makes consolidation plausible, but it fits the digital strategy and management would rather merge it than withdraw it outright.
The manhole door with safety railing extends the established hardware line with low ongoing cost and steady municipal demand, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
The sludge extractor belongs to the core water machinery business, and slow uptake can be attributed to long municipal procurement cycles and pandemic delays, which supports persisting with it.
Control technology for water engineering machinery links the firm's machinery to its automation strategy and is central to the integrated-solutions direction it has announced.
Flow measurement automation software is recent, had its own page, and fits the connected, data-driven infrastructure direction, so the firm would keep investing in it.
